name: property-search-hero
title: Property search hero
description: A real-estate opening with Buy, Rent and Sold tabs over one search row: place, price range, bedrooms and popular places with counts.
docs: Prices in priceSteps are whole currency units (150000 is 150,000), one list per mode. Switching mode swaps the steps, keeps a price that exists in the new list, clears one that does not, and announces the change politely. With no place chosen the button says Search everywhere, so a search never dead-ends. onSearch is a function, so use the hero inside a Client Component.
